The safety of equipment is a key safety mechanism in the design of equipment, its role is to prevent overheating of equipment, prevent fire, protect the safety of operators, and extend the life of equipment. The use of this system can lead to the following consequences: ** Safety hazards ** - The operation of the equipment overheating through the temperature sensor or time relay control equipment, the circumvention of the system can lead to the equipment continuing operation and not timely dissipate heat, causing fire or damage to the equipment. - Personal injury: The high temperature equipment can cause injury to the operator, induce high temperature or electrical hazards, etc.
